jdk.imageDigestNote: plan 8.4 asks for an immutable IMAGE digest, which presumes a container. This reference is a JDK installed on the host, so there is no image and none is invented. `releaseFileSha256` pins the distribution's own identity instead and is named differently so it cannot be read as the thing the plan asked for.
